newsitem.title: USA: Investor ups Marisa Christina stake.
newsitem.headline: Investor ups Marisa Christina stake.

text.p: New York investor Edwin Marks and his family members and entities said they raised their stake in Marisa Christina Inc. to 785,988 shares, or 9.32 percent of the total outstanding, from 659,088 shares, or 7.82 percent.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Marks group said it bought 126,900 shares on Jan. 27 and 30 at prices ranging from $8.00 to $8.06 a share.
Marks is president of his family business, CMCO Inc., a Great Neck, N.Y., holding company for various stock and limited partnership interests.
